_meta.auth_handshake: first frame on every connection: {"id":"auth","method":"auth","params":{"token":"<64-hex from --control-token-file>"}} -> {"id":"auth","ok":true,"result":{"authenticated":true}}
_meta.app_version: not exposed on the wire (no version method); source tree Cargo.toml workspace version = 0.5.0 at ~/Downloads/CRAFT/photocraft-main
notes: Bare JSON array of command entries is the `result` payload (engine `command.list`).

menu = menu path array (empty = not in menus). params = human/agent-readable JSON-ish doc STRING, not a JSON schema. shortcut = egui-style notation. enabled = session state at query time (197/818 were false at capture).

Desktop control channel IGNORES any `filter` param on engine.commands (control.rs wraps `command.list` with empty params) - verified live: filter=blend and filter=zzzNoMatchzzz both returned all 818 entries. Headless rpc.rs DOES filter.

These are ENGINE registry ids. UI menu ids (800 entries from `ui.menu.list`, fields id/label/path/shortcut/enabled/checked, e.g. file.clearRecent, view.zoomIn) are NOT here but still run via engine.execute (control.rs falls through to menus::invoke for non-engine ids).
The identical field set is produced by headless `command.list` (crates/engine/src/commands.rs) and the automation headless command_list (crates/automation/src/headless.rs).
image.mode.* ids are listed (enabled:true reflects engine preconditions only) but the DESKTOP automation refuses them (crates/automation/src/workspace.rs authorize_desktop_engine_command).

commands.label: Play Action
commands.params: {"action":name|index, "from":step?} → {action, ran, failed?:{step, id, error}}. step and from are 0-based. Stops at the first error (the command still returns ok, with failed set) and leaves one history step per step that ran. Refuses to play while a play is already running. Each step is checked with Session::authorize when one is installed.
